lossless_factorization.axis_rule: select unique axis a with Q_a>Q_b for all b!=a; exact axis-score ties unresolved
lossless_factorization.orientation_rule: within selected axis, select + or - iff its B is strictly larger; exact orientation tie unresolved
proof_cases: direct unique max d implies its axis max equals B_d and strictly exceeds every other axis max; orientation within its axis is unique
if staged selector resolves d, selected axis max strictly exceeds other axes and d strictly exceeds its opposite orientation, so d is the direct unique global max
any direct global tie either creates an axis-score tie or an orientation tie, hence both formulations preserve unresolved
lossless_factorization.theorem: the staged AXIS_MAX then ORIENTATION_MAX partial selector is exactly equivalent to direct six-way unique argmax for every nonnegative endpoint-count vector B
